statutory_reconciliation_note: Effective 1 April 2026, the Government of India revised STT on F&O trades (Futures sell-side rate increased from 0.02% to 0.05%, Options sell-side premium rate increased from 0.10% to 0.15%). Broker pricing websites may lag statutory Gazette updates; this calculator reconciles and applies statutory rules on and after 1 April 2026.
